conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Increase SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this mode carries substantially higher drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs decay daily, meaning losses can accumulate very quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.
